title: Shell-structure reading of the neutron-prediction residuals
html:
Remark. Shell-structure reading of the neutron-prediction residuals

The beta-stability formula yields a smooth prediction. Discrepancies |\Delta n| \geq 2 cluster at:

  1. Stability pair closures (n = 20, 28, 50, 82, 126). The formula passes smoothly through these points.
  2. Transuranic elements (p > 92). Observed isotopes possess half-lives too short to pinpoint stability.

The smooth formula derives the neutron excess from q. The residuals encode shell structure. Characterizing this structure remains the goal of the elliptic stability conjecture.
